developer_instruction: Refresh PR #211 metadata and the branch HEAD before any write. Continue autonomously from the frozen v1.1 staff-line result. Do not merge. Do not open new holdout data. Preserve all source/teacher/restored-data boundaries and stop at the explicit gates below.

adr_0036.purpose: Separates detector development, teacher scoring, qualification, holdout and restored-output comparison.

flexibility_principles.purpose: Adds the rule that source-detector development, scoring and qualification are separate layers.

consistency_audit.purpose: Adds the 2026-09-13 Stage 11 V2d staff-line architecture overlay and current gate.

current_problem.summary: V1.1 materially improves coverage and recall without losing precision/specificity, but it still misses 106 of 197 teacher-confirmed systems at the 0.5-spacing diagnostic. The same spent development corpus cannot qualify staff_line.
current_problem.primary_failure: insufficient source-detector recall on faint, broken, skewed or locally weak staff-line systems while preserving text/TAB rejection

primary_goal: Freeze a qualification/acceptance policy before any fresh holdout, then develop a separately versioned v1.2 source-only staff-line candidate on the already-spent 20-page development corpus. Improve recall materially without sacrificing precision, absent-page specificity, TAB rejection or determinism. Freeze v1.2 source output before teacher scoring. Stop before any new independent holdout or restored-output comparison.
important_threshold_rule: The development targets above are not qualification thresholds. Do not silently convert them into PASS criteria. Create and freeze a separate qualification policy with explicit rationale before any fresh holdout is opened.
technical_focus: Keep v1 and v1.1 immutable; create a new v1.2 module/test/evidence namespace.
Use source-derived multi-scale horizontal evidence with bounded deterministic fusion.
Improve sensitivity to faded/broken staff ridges without admitting text baselines or decorative horizontal structure.
Use local spacing evidence and cross-staff suppression; do not use page-specific thresholds.
Retain or strengthen staff-height/topology sanity checks.
Retain skew tolerance only when deterministic and bounded.
Retain tolerant six-line neighbor rejection so guitar TAB lanes are not promoted to five-line staff systems.
Prefer auditable source-derived diagnostics: ridge/segment support, strip support, local gap modes, candidate rejection reasons and deduplication reasons.
Do not use teacher coordinates as inference input or tune a page rule to a teacher box.

B0_refresh_and_lock: Refresh PR #211 and branch HEAD before writes.
Read ADR 0036, architecture consistency audit, architecture flexibility principles and V2D current truth.
Confirm PR is Draft/Open/Unmerged and merge remains unauthorized.
B1_freeze_qualification_policy: Create a versioned staff_line qualification/acceptance policy artifact before any fresh holdout access.
Predeclare matching rule, metrics, threshold semantics, staff-absent specificity, determinism, line-count/order, TAB rejection, failure/abstention behavior and evidence binding.
Do not use a fresh holdout to select or move thresholds.
Do not declare staff_line PASS from development data.
B2_source_only_root_cause: Use only the already-spent 20-page source corpus.
Keep teacher coordinate files closed during candidate generation/inference.
Instrument v1.1/v1.2 source diagnostics to isolate missed faint/broken systems and false-positive suppressors.
B3_implement_v1_2: Preserve v1/v1.1 files and evidence unchanged.

Add deterministic synthetic/local tests for five-line acceptance, six-line TAB rejection, text/decorative rejection, cross-staff suppression, faint/broken lines, skew tolerance, blank pages, and identity mismatch.
B4_full20_source_only_ablation: Run all 20 exact frozen source pages source-only.
Compare source-only behavior against frozen v1.1 without teacher coordinates.
Reject explosive candidate growth, staff-absent contamination or obvious TAB promotion before freeze.
B5_freeze_v1_2: Select the smallest defensible v1.2 candidate.
Freeze exact code SHA/config/source SHA inventory/raw JSON and SHA sidecar.
Verify byte-repeat determinism and 20/20 source identity.
Set sourceOnly=true, teacherUsedAtInference=false, restoredUsedAtInference=false, heldOutAccessed=false, trainingUsed=false and pageSpecificRulesUsed=false.
B6_teacher_score_after_freeze: Only after B5, score the frozen v1.2 output against the existing 20-page teacher topology.
Use the same one-to-one 0.5 staff-spacing diagnostic used for v1/v1.1 plus any metrics frozen in the qualification policy.
If v1.2 is insufficient, record REJECTED_CURRENT_DETECTOR or development-only candidate status; do not retune the same frozen v1.2 after seeing teacher results.
B7_compare_and_decide: Compare baseline, v1, v1.1 and v1.2 on identical development diagnostics.
Development improvement may justify another version but cannot qualify staff_line.
Prepare, but do not execute, a fresh independent holdout plan if the frozen qualification policy and development evidence justify it.
B8_ci_and_docs: Run Python 3.11 and 3.12 staff-line validation on the exact new HEAD.
Update V2D current truth, architecture consistency overlay and PR body with observed facts only.
B9_stop_gate: STOP before any fresh independent holdout access.
STOP before production, Stage 11 overall PASS, or Stage 12 authorization.
